scripts.codegen: cargo run -p santi-api -- export-openapi > packages/contracts/openapi.json && pnpm exec orval --config orval.config.ts && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/contracts/src/openapi.ts
scripts.guard: pnpm guard:repo && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --workspace && pnpm codegen && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.guard:hooks: python3 -m py_compile scripts/init.py && python3 scripts/init.py --check && hooks=$(git rev-parse --git-path hooks) && sh -n "$hooks/pre-commit" && sh -n "$hooks/commit-msg"
